messages:
Tomas (AE): Hey team — ApexWave wants to run a 2-week POC for their retrieval-augmented chat using the new 'wave-70b' variant. Main asks: latency <200ms p95, cost estimate for demo traffic (~150k tokens/day), and security questionnaire answers.
Aisha (Solutions): Thanks. Do we know if they need KV cache persistence or just in-memory? That affects memory layout and quant options.
Tomas (AE): They said short conversations, but want session affinity so KV cache across requests is desired.
Ravi (Infra): KV persistence + session affinity means we should recommend dedicated pools or at least reserved capacity for demo. For wave-70b quant-> int8 preferred. Any known compatibility with our MLP norm kernels?
Maya (ML): wave-70b has RMSNorm variants — our runtime supports RMSNorm fallback but some optimized kernels aren't available for the trimmed variant. For int8, we recommend the 'symmetric-quant' profile; it keeps perf within 8-12% of float at much lower mem.
Aisha (Solutions): Good — we'll include two pricing options: Hosted (burstable, pay-as-you-go) and Dedicated reserved (1-month trial), with quant guidance. Tomas can you confirm demo traffic baseline?
Tomas (AE): Baseline = 150k tokens/day, peak concurrent sessions ~40, median sequence length ~120 tokens. They want a ballpark by EOD.
Ravi (Infra): Quick calc: with int8 symmetric and batching 16, we can hit ~160ms p95 on A100s for that seq len. Cost estimate (hosted) ~ $0.013/token inference -> that's obviously wrong for published rates, but for demo we'll propose: Hosted ≈ $900/day, Dedicated minimal ≈ $650/day + infra commit. I'll draft numbers.
Maya (ML): Also note some plug-in extractors they use (custom tokenizer) need tokenization mapping. If they're using proprietary tokenizer, we should validate token IDs match wave-70b vocab. Can Solutions get a small sample?
Aisha (Solutions): I'll ask ApexWave for a 1k-line sample and the security contact. Also need to confirm whether they require KMS/HSM for keys during Private deployment trial.
Tomas (AE): They flagged SOC2 + encryption at rest, and will send the security questionnaire. Can someone own the security answers?
Ravi (Infra): I'll take the KMS/HSM + network isolation questions. Maya can handle model-level questions (quant, KV, tokenizer). Aisha please attach the questionnaire here once received.
Aisha (Solutions): On it. Quick note for the proposal: we'll offer a fallback model policy — wave-35b slim — if memory or latency SLOs are missed. That usually satisfies enterprise procurement.
Maya (ML): Agree. Also include note about output parity checks for quantized variant and an eval suite run on their sample prompts.
Tomas (AE): Great. Action items: Aisha request sample + questionnaire; Ravi draft infra answers + quick cost calc; Maya run tokenizer compatibility test once sample arrives. I'll consolidate and send to ApexWave.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: reserved-pool estimate job queued #45392 — ETA ~15m.
Ravi (Infra): Ping after deploy estimate finishes, I'll adjust numbers.
Aisha (Solutions): Thanks all — will update in thread when I hear back. :thumbsup:
